name: Claymores
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee Infantry · special · 235 leadership · Seasonal & Honour Unit

unlock: Unlocked through challenges across three tiers - the fourth tier unlocks the unit's unique doctrine (skill cooldown reduction)

pitch: A damage dealer and team buffer wrapped in a brutally long cooldown cycle — activate For Freedom!, execute your combo, and vanish before the 10-second Crippling debuff lands, or lose the unit almost instantly. The unit is really bad without For Freedom! up, so the whole combo exists to protect that buff window.

doctrines.name: Linebreaker Doctrine V
doctrines.effect: Every 3 attacks: block-break boost vs enemy units, 2s.

doctrines.name: Epic Combat Doctrine
doctrines.effect: After every 3 attacks: next attack's DMG +11%. Every 6 attacks: restores 15% max HP. Every 9 attacks: 2.5s CC immunity.
doctrines.note: stacking: every 3rd atk +11% dmg, every 6th +15% HP, every 9th 2.5s CCi

doctrines.name: Unshakable Ward
doctrines.effect: Immune to daze & knock for 7s + immune to fire/bleed dmg. Top pick.
doctrines.note: immune to daze & knock 7s + immune to fire/bleed dmg

doctrines.name: Flat defence doctrines
doctrines.note: already reach minimum dmg taken often

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Lower skill cooldowns, +10% Claymore Strike damage, larger For Freedom! damage bonus — more kills but fragile and dependent on For Freedom! uptime. House leadership independently confirms top line.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Heavy defensive stats, 15% damage reduction during charge (ends on swing), +9% reduction during Fearless Heart, doubles For Freedom! bonus HP — extremely tanky, low overall damage, valuable as a durable buff-provider.

battleRole.positioning: Approach as a flanker anchored to your team — stick with allies to apply team buffs and survive the cooldown cycle. {3} Never solo-flank blindly; vulnerable to skill-cancel CC/daze. {3} For Freedom! increases targets hit by regular attacks/skills; time key skills when allies are nearby. {3}
battleRole.tips: Open: X-move in, press 3 (For Freedom!) to buff yourself before taking any hits. {1} Combo: instantly press 2 (Claymore Strike) when in melee, let them hit once, press V (makes press 2 hit once again), into 1 (Highland Charge) or retreat (preferred). {1} Exit: get out and wait for cooldown if possible — it's better than anything. {1} Train the combo in custom game first. {1} Fearless Heart triggers on offensive skills — 10% damage reduction for 5s, restores up to 750 HP, reduces melee damage taken by the unit and nearby allies by 20%; while For Freedom! active, healing sometimes doubled and melee reduction increases to 35%. {3} On For Freedom! expiry: 10-second Crippling debuff heavily drops movement speed, attack rate, and damage while raising damage taken — pull out 2–3s early using the buff's own speed boost; if still fighting on expiry, expect to lose the unit almost instantly. {3} Skills can't be used while Crippling is active; any in-progress charge is canceled. {3}

cards.name: Stalwart/Phalanx
cards.why: Counters Claymores depending on how they play (Claymores still win with Linebreaker in most cases). {1}

cards.name: Rattan Vipers
cards.why: Poison stacks turn Charge into a non-threat; shown losing most damage output mid-charge. {4}

matchups.pressure: You pressure: nearly everything — Claymores counter "near everything" per Amya {1}. House leadership predicts a heavy-meta run in Purple Lock and Gold this season {2}.

controls.notes: For Freedom! — signature 15-second buff: increases movement speed, damage, max HP, massively boosts Charge's block-break, adds snare to Claymore Strike, boosts Fearless Heart's effect, increases targets hit by attacks/skills; activation animation cancelable with a skill or V; can be activated mid-charge. {3} Highland Charge — standard infantry charge with a slow swing at the end; charging point-blank skips the charge animation for an immediate swing (~5% damage bonus over regular attacks only); triggers Fearless Heart after the swing. {3} Claymore Strike — three strikes, each dealing 20 bonus damage, short activation range (outside it the unit swings in air); also triggers Fearless Heart. {3} Passive "battle happy" trait grants up to 200 armor on hits — avoid engaging before stacks accumulate. {3}

gaps: Formation guidance absent — no source specifies F1/F2 or spacing geometry.
Exact For Freedom! damage bonus varies per skill/veterancy line; in-game description claims +40% but actual bonus not uniformly applicable.

Skill names vary by source: one video transcript spells them 'Feor Freedom' and 'Fearless Heart', but the primary source (matching Amya) uses 'For Freedom!' - go with that one. The core mechanics match either way.
No house-card build exists; house leadership (Bohemiansnacksody, StaRBuRsT) confirms top-vet preference and predicts a heavy-meta season but supplies no doctrine details beyond veterancy line choice.
